title: 🏛️ Exam 2022 · writing prepared: my winter holiday ⭐⭐⭐

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2022 — writing, question 2)
Task: "It is your winter holiday. You always spend it with your family. Write an e-mail to your friend to tell him/her about: where you spend it, clothes you wear, food and drinks, your activities." Which plan covers the four points of the task?

options.text: Where I spend it · my winter clothes · my food and drinks · my activities
Where I spend it · my winter clothes · my school marks · my activities
Where I spend it · my winter clothes · my food and drinks · my homework
Where I spend it · my food and drinks · my activities

questions.explanation: The task lists four points: the place, the clothes, the food and drinks, and the activities, and a good plan keeps all four and nothing else. The plans with school marks or homework replace one point by an idea nobody asked for, and the plan without the clothes forgets a point of the task.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2022 — writing, question 2)
In your e-mail you write about the clothes you wear on a cold winter day. Which of these clothes keep you warm?

options.text: a sweater
gloves
a swimsuit
boots
shorts

questions.explanation: A sweater keeps the body warm, gloves keep the hands warm and boots keep the feet warm. A swimsuit and shorts are summer clothes: they leave the skin bare, so they do not belong in an e-mail about a cold winter day.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2022 — writing, question 2)
You tell your friend about the weather in winter in your town: it is cold and there is a strong wind. Which sentence is correct?

options.text: It's cold and wind in winter.
It's cold and winddy in winter.
It's cold and windy in winter.
It cold and windy in winter.

questions.explanation: The answer to What's the weather like? opens with It's and takes adjectives, and the adjective of wind is the noun plus y: windy. The noun wind cannot stand after and in a description, winddy doubles a letter after a consonant where nothing is doubled, and the sentence without 's has no verb.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2022 — writing, question 2)
The task asks for the food and drinks of your winter holiday. Which sentence belongs in that part of the e-mail?

options.text: My cousin has a new bicycle, and he rides it every day.
We drink hot tea and eat soup with bread.
The shops are open until eight o'clock in the evening.
I always do my homework before I go to bed.

questions.explanation: This part of the e-mail tells what you eat and drink in winter, and hot tea and soup are exactly that. The sentences about a bicycle, the opening hours of the shops and homework may all be true, but none of them is about food or drinks, so they do not answer this point of the task.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2022 — writing, question 2)
You are Karim and you write to your friend Amir. The e-mail starts with "Dear Amir," and ends with a closing line. Which closing line is correct?

options.text: Yours, Amir
Dear Karim,
Subject: My winter holiday
Yours, Karim

questions.explanation: The closing line is signed with the name of the writer, Karim, after a polite word such as Yours. The line Yours, Amir signs with the name of the friend who receives the e-mail, Dear Karim is an opening line, and a line that starts with Subject belongs at the top of the e-mail, not at its end.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2022 — writing, question 2)
In the part about your activities you write: "In winter my cousins and I enjoy ___ hot tea at home and ___ in the snow." Which pair of words is correct?

options.text: drink ... running
drinking ... running
drinking ... runing
drink ... runing

questions.explanation: After enjoy the activity takes the -ing form, so the first word is drinking, and run is consonant plus vowel plus consonant, so it doubles its last letter: running. The bare verb drink forgets the -ing that follows enjoy, and the spelling runing forgets the doubled n.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2022 — writing, question 2)
Put the sentences of the e-mail in the right order.

options.text: Every winter my family and I stay in a small house in the mountains.
In the evening we eat hot soup and drink tea.
In the mountains it is very cold, so I wear a warm sweater, gloves and boots.
Write back soon and tell me about your holiday.
Hello Amir! Here is the news about my winter holiday.
In the morning we enjoy walking in the snow.

questions.explanation: The e-mail opens with a hello and the news to come, and ends with a wish to hear from the friend. The place comes first, because the mountains are introduced there and the next sentence speaks about them again; the clothes follow. Then the day goes from the morning to the evening, so the walk in the snow comes before the hot soup.
